contract.purpose: Turn a ChatGPT export into a private browser-computed map of recurring themes, facts, emotions, questions, and change.
contract.purposeSource: Site Health purposeContract plus PRODUCT.md and current implementation
contract.canonicalPurpose: Memory Map turns an exported AI conversation history into a private map of recurring themes, facts, emotions, and change.
contract.driftNote: The landing accurately limits the current import to ChatGPT and does not imply accounts, server uploads, cross-device sync, or verified personality and medical claims.
contract.audience: People curious about patterns in their ChatGPT history who are unwilling to upload the archive to an application server.
contract.job: Understand the privacy boundary, obtain an export if needed, choose an analysis lens, and import the original ZIP locally.
contract.thesis: A private archive becomes a navigable transit map whose routes always lead back to source evidence.
contract.system: Cool paper, ink rules, cobalt route signals, teal privacy cues, restrained red alerts, monospace map keys, and native evidence controls.
contract.signature: The import gate reads like a transit interchange: analysis lenses, a ZIP platform, three route stages, and an explicit privacy contract.
contract.risk: The product exposes many post-import views, so the pre-import landing keeps one dominant task and links to the complete capability inventory rather than presenting a feature wall.

answers.product: Memory Map is a browser-local analyzer for a ChatGPT export ZIP.
answers.audience: People who want to understand recurring patterns in their history without uploading the archive.
answers.value: It turns an unwieldy conversation archive into searchable themes, facts, repeats, historical shifts, and evidence-linked routes.
answers.mechanism: The browser parses conversation JSON, applies inspectable rules and local embeddings, and keeps archive text and derived content on the device.
answers.proof: The landing names 51 inspectable outputs, exposes analysis-lens and confidence controls, and explains how every suggestion traces back to source conversations.
answers.nextAction: Choose the original ChatGPT export ZIP or follow the embedded official export guide.

accessibility.note: Raised the two sub-threshold labels in the analysis-lens and privacy-contract surfaces; exact mobile Lighthouse now reports no accessibility failures.
